questions.promptEn:
05 다음 조건에 맞게 대화를 완성하시오.
G: Hello. I'd like to buy a bag.
M: Okay. We have two colors, white and black. Which do you prefer?
G: I prefer white to black.
M: Then you can choose between these two bags.
G: They both look nice. ______ one for me?
M: How about the one with the flower on it? It's popular with our customers.

조건: can을 이용하여 총 3단어로 쓸 것.
accept: Can you recommend

G: Yes, there are. ⓐ 너는 어떤 걸 더 좋아하니?
B: Hmm... I'm not sure. Can you recommend one?
G: Sure! I think the one with the cloud pattern would look great on your phone.
B: I like that one, too. I'll get ⓑ it then. Thank you!

06 위 대화의 밑줄 친 우리말 ⓐ에 맞도록 네 단어로 영작하시오.

questions.promptEn:

B: Hi, Ginny. Wow! You have a lot of things for sale!

The next day, I got ready to go to the park. I decided to borrow a bike instead of taking a bus. My city has a bike-sharing system. Anyone who has an app can borrow a bike easily. First, you choose a bike that you want to use. Then you scan the QR code on the bike. ⓐ This makes the bike's lock close.

Before I rode to the park, I checked the bike carefully. Sometimes, the bikes are not in good condition. This time, everything looked fine, so I headed for the park.
